query.sql: SELECT v.scenario_name, x."口径", x."收益率（%）" FROM vi_valuation v JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = v.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '002078.SZ' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('隐含收益率', round((v.implied_irr * 100)::numeric, 2)), ('现金支持口径', round((v.cash_implied_irr * 100)::numeric, 2)), ('要求收益率', round((v.required_return * 100)::numeric, 2))) x("口径", "收益率（%）") ORDER BY v.sort, 2

SELECT x.price AS "买入价", '隐含收益率' AS "系列", round((vi_irr(f.divs, f.taus, f.td, f.ttau, f.cf_g, x.price) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS "收益率" FROM vi_valuation_cf f JOIN vi_scenario_base s ON s.id = f.scenario_id AND s.is_base JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = f.model_id JOIN vi_company_calc cc ON cc.id = m.company_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '002078.SZ' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' CROSS JOIN generate_series(greatest(1, floor(cc.latest_price * 0.5))::int, ceil(cc.latest_price * 1.6)::int) x(price) UNION ALL SELECT x.price, '要求收益率', round((f.required_return * 100)::numeric, 2) FROM vi_valuation_cf f JOIN vi_scenario_base s ON s.id = f.scenario_id AND s.is_base JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = f.model_id JOIN vi_company_calc cc ON cc.id = m.company_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '002078.SZ' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' CROSS JOIN generate_series(greatest(1, floor(cc.latest_price * 0.5))::int, ceil(cc.latest_price * 1.6)::int) x(price) ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT round((x.r * 100)::numeric, 1)::text || '%' AS "要求收益率", s.name AS "情景", round(vi_pv(f.divs, f.taus, f.td, f.ttau, f.cf_g, x.r)::numeric, 2) AS "最高买入价", x.r, s.sort FROM vi_valuation_cf f JOIN vi_scenario_base s ON s.id = f.scenario_id JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = f.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '002078.SZ' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' CROSS JOIN (SELECT generate_series(40, 100, 5) / 1000.0 AS r) x UNION ALL SELECT round((x.r * 100)::numeric, 1)::text || '%', '市场价', round(cc.latest_price::numeric, 2), x.r, 99 FROM vi_model_base m JOIN vi_company_calc cc ON cc.id = m.company_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '002078.SZ' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' CROSS JOIN (SELECT generate_series(40, 100, 5) / 1000.0 AS r) x ORDER BY 4, 5

SELECT v.scenario_name, round(v.value_today::numeric, 2) AS "今天每股价值" FROM vi_valuation v JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = v.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '002078.SZ' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' ORDER BY v.sort

SELECT v.scenario_name, '今天价值' AS item, round(v.value_today::numeric, 2) AS price, v.sort FROM vi_valuation v JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = v.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '002078.SZ' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' UNION ALL SELECT v.scenario_name, '低档关注价', round(v.watch_low::numeric, 2), v.sort FROM vi_valuation v JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = v.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '002078.SZ' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' UNION ALL SELECT v.scenario_name, '高档关注价', round(v.watch_high::numeric, 2), v.sort FROM vi_valuation v JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = v.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '002078.SZ' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' UNION ALL SELECT v.scenario_name, '市场价', round(v.market_price::numeric, 2), v.sort FROM vi_valuation v JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = v.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '002078.SZ' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' ORDER BY sort, item

SELECT v.scenario_name, round(v.terminal_share::numeric, 4) AS "终值占比" FROM vi_valuation v JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = v.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '002078.SZ' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' ORDER BY v.sort

SELECT p.year, x.item, round(x.amount::numeric, 1) AS amount FROM vi_projection p JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = p.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '002078.SZ' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('归母净利润', p.np_parent), ('计划股息', p.dividend), ('FCFE', p.fcfe)) x(item, amount) WHERE p.is_base ORDER BY p.year, x.item

SELECT round((s.r * 100)::numeric, 2)::text || '%' AS r, 'g=' || round((s.g * 100)::numeric, 2)::text || '%' AS g, round(s.value_today::numeric, 2) AS value FROM vi_sensitivity s JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = s.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '002078.SZ' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' ORDER BY s.r, s.g

SELECT h.year::text AS year, '历史' AS kind, round(h.interest_debt::numeric, 0) AS debt FROM vi_fin_history_base h JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = h.company_id AND co.code = '002078.SZ' WHERE h.interest_debt IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT f.year::text, '预测', round(fc.debt_close::numeric, 0) FROM vi_forecast_base f JOIN vi_forecast_calc fc USING (id) JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = f.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '002078.SZ' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' ORDER BY year

SELECT h.year, x.item, x.amount FROM vi_fin_history_base h JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = h.company_id AND co.code = '002078.SZ' CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('归母净利润', h.np_parent), ('分红总额', h.dividend_total)) x(item, amount) WHERE x.amount IS NOT NULL ORDER BY h.year, x.item

SELECT h.year, x.item, x.amount FROM vi_fin_history_base h JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = h.company_id AND co.code = '002078.SZ' CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('经营现金流', h.cfo), ('资本开支', h.capex)) x(item, amount) WHERE x.amount IS NOT NULL ORDER BY h.year, x.item

SELECT h.year, x.item, round((x.v * 100)::numeric, 1) AS pct FROM vi_fin_history_base h JOIN vi_fin_history_calc hc USING (id) JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = h.company_id AND co.code = '002078.SZ' CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('毛利率', hc.gross_margin), ('ROE', hc.roe)) x(item, v) WHERE x.v IS NOT NULL ORDER BY h.year, x.item

SELECT h.year, round(h.volume::numeric, CASE WHEN h.volume < 100 THEN 3 ELSE 0 END) AS "业务量" FROM vi_fin_history_base h JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = h.company_id AND co.code = '002078.SZ' WHERE h.volume IS NOT NULL ORDER BY h.year
SELECT f.dimension AS "维度", f.score AS "评分" FROM vi_fit_score_base f JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = f.company_id AND co.code = '002078.SZ' ORDER BY f.sort, f.id

SELECT m.code || ' ' || left(m.title, 14) AS "壁垒", CASE m.strength WHEN '强' THEN 3 WHEN '中' THEN 2 WHEN '弱' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "强度", coalesce(m.verdict, '待验证') AS "判定" FROM vi_moat_base m JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '002078.SZ' ORDER BY m.code

SELECT v.code || ' ' || left(v.participant, 12) AS "环节", v.force AS "五力", CASE v.power WHEN '强' THEN 3 WHEN '中' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END * CASE v.effect WHEN '有利' THEN 1 WHEN '不利' THEN -1 ELSE 0 END AS "影响" FROM vi_value_chain_base v JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = v.company_id AND co.code = '002078.SZ' ORDER BY v.code

SELECT c.name AS "对手", x.k AS "指标", round((x.v * 100)::numeric, 1) AS "%" FROM vi_competitor_base c JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = c.company_id AND co.code = '002078.SZ' CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('付费率或渗透率', c.paying_rate), ('毛利率', c.gross_margin), ('增速', c.growth)) x(k, v) WHERE x.v IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT co.name || '（本公司）', x.k, round((x.v * 100)::numeric, 1) FROM vi_fin_history_base h JOIN vi_fin_history_calc hc USING (id) JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = h.company_id AND co.code = '002078.SZ' CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('毛利率', hc.gross_margin), ('增速', hc.revenue_yoy)) x(k, v) WHERE x.v IS NOT NULL AND h.year = (SELECT max(h2.year) FROM vi_fin_history_base h2 WHERE h2.company_id = h.company_id) ORDER BY 1, 2
SELECT coalesce(t.status, '未裁决') AS "裁决", count(*) AS n FROM vi_thesis_base t JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = t.company_id AND co.code = '002078.SZ' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT d.period, d.line_item, round((d.yoy * 100)::numeric, 1) AS "同比（%）" FROM vi_period_data_base d JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = d.company_id AND co.code = '002078.SZ' WHERE d.period_kind = '单季' AND d.yoy IS NOT NULL ORDER BY d.period_end, d.line_item

SELECT k.result, count(*) AS n FROM vi_check k JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = k.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '002078.SZ' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' GROUP BY k.result ORDER BY k.result
SELECT f.verify_status, count(*) AS n FROM vi_fact_base f JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = f.company_id AND co.code = '002078.SZ' GROUP BY f.verify_status ORDER BY n DESC

SELECT o.obs_date, round((CASE WHEN co.price_fx_metric_id IS NULL THEN o.value ELSE o.value * fx.value END)::numeric, 2) AS "股价" FROM vi_obs_current o JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.price_metric_id = o.metric_id AND co.code = '002078.SZ' LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT x.value FROM vi_obs_current x WHERE x.metric_id = co.price_fx_metric_id AND x.obs_date <= o.obs_date ORDER BY x.obs_date DESC LIMIT 1) fx ON true ORDER BY o.obs_date
SELECT o.obs_date, o.value AS "数值" FROM vi_obs_current o JOIN vi_metric_base mt ON mt.id = o.metric_id WHERE mt.code = 'CGB10Y.CCDC' ORDER BY o.obs_date

SELECT o.obs_date, mt.name AS "口径", o.value AS "价格" FROM vi_obs_current o JOIN vi_metric_base mt ON mt.id = o.metric_id WHERE mt.code IN ('SP.SHFE.WIND', 'SP.SHFE.SINA') AND o.obs_date >= current_date - 730 ORDER BY o.obs_date, 2
SELECT d.period, d.value AS "毛利率（%）" FROM vi_period_data_base d JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = d.company_id AND co.code = '002078.SZ' WHERE d.line_item = '毛利率' ORDER BY d.period_end

买入价 → 隐含年化收益率（基准情景，%）
要求收益率 → 最高买入价（元）
三情景·今天每股价值（元）
今天价值、关注价与市场价（元）
终值占比（越高越依赖远期）
基准情景：利润、股息与 FCFE（亿元）
敏感性：今天每股价值（元）
带息负债：历史与预测（亿元）
历史：归母净利润与分红总额（亿元）
历史：经营现金流与资本开支（亿元）
历史：毛利率与 ROE（%）
历史：浆纸销量（纸＋外销浆）（万吨）
价值投资适配度（各维度 0—5 分）
竞争壁垒：强度（强 3、中 2、弱 1、无 0）与判定
产业链与五力：对公司的影响（有利为正、不利为负，强 3、中 2、弱 1）
竞争对手对比（%）：付费率、毛利率、增速
论点与辩论：裁决（成立 / 观察 / 存疑 / 证伪）
定期经营数据：单季同比（%）
自动检查结果
事实卡核验状态
市场：股价（元；境外报价按当日汇率折算）
市场：中债国债10年收益率（%）
市场：纸浆期货（元/吨，两个口径分开画）
定期经营数据：单季毛利率（%）
